messages:
Ana Li: Quick async check — microkernel rollforward status? Please post short updates (1–2 lines) + any blockers. Targeting canary tomorrow EOD. @Kevin, you own kernel PR. @Priya, KV prefetch tuning. @Sam infra canary capacity. :eyes:

Kevin M: Kernel PR is green locally; CI flaky on 2 tests (attention_cache_test, seqpad). Running repros now. Perf bench on the branch shows ~18% p99 latency reduction at seq_len=1024 and ~12% throughput uplift in microbench. Need one more perf run with real traffic profile before canary. Asking for one more reviewer.

Priya Rao: KV prefetch tweak landed in staging. Small config change applied: 
```
kv.prefetch.window_ms = 200
kv.prefetch.max_prefetch = 64
```
Early results: hit rate +6%, mem +1.8%. Eviction heuristics still noisy on bursty traffic — tracking in incident 723. Will run a 12h soak tonight.

Sam O'Neill: Infra note — dedicated canary pool size is currently 8 GPUs; with continuous batching (batch_timeout=10ms) we project peak queue depth that requires 12 GPUs to keep p99 SLO. I can scale temporarily but need approval for the short-term spend. Also toggling cross-region fallback (standby pool) is ready.

Maya Patel: From product — don't enable rollout to full prod until fallback policy is exercised and rollback is validated. Please prepare a one-paragraph customer comms for oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for canary: microkernel-roll-4155002468 -> staging -> canary. CI status: 3/5 checks passed (unit, lint, perf).

Kevin M: PTAL @Ana Li @Priya Rao — left review comments on PR https://git.redwood.ai/r/runtime/kernel/pulls/432. If someone can approve by 16:00 PT we can start canary later today. Also logging an opt-in flag: `--enable-microkernel-rollforward` for safer rollback.

Ana Li: Ownership recap: Kevin = kernel PR + review, Priya = KV tuning + soak, Sam = infra scaling + canary pool, Maya = rollout approvals + comms. Quick sync at 15:30 PT if we still have flaky CI or perf divergence. If blockers persist ping me directly. :thumbsup:
